summary.text: OSLO BONANZA AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 2009-07-01. Oslo Bonanza AS drives restaurants, and its statutory purpose also covers trade and participation in businesses of a similar economic nature. Its main industry code is 56.110: restaurant activities. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 9 275 623 NOK and the annual result was 883 569 NOK; operating income was up from 6 584 877 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from -618 407 NOK in 2024 to 883 569 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 571 038 NOK in 2024 to 1 207 426 NOK in 2025. The registered employee count went from 12 on 2026-04-14 to 15 on 2026-09-15. Recent changes in the register: postal address set to c/o Gerhard & Sønn AS, Hausmanns gate 27 on 2026-03-12.
